# ActionCard

A card that is one link: illustration or icon, a headline, optional description, an arrow affordance. The whole surface is the target and the headline is the accessible name.

## Accessibility

WCAG 2.2 AA: `1.1.1`, `1.4.1`, `1.4.3`, `1.4.11`, `2.1.1`, `2.4.4`, `2.4.7`, `2.5.8`

- `Tab`: moves focus to the card as one stop
- `Enter`: follows the link
- One link, one accessible name: the headline text. Media, icon and chevron are aria-hidden so the name is not padded with noise.
- No interactive element may be nested inside the card (a link inside a link is invalid HTML and unreachable by keyboard).
- Focus ring is drawn on the whole card surface (2.4.7) and the target is at least 24×24 (2.5.8).
- Headline and description meet 4.5:1 on the card surface; the chevron and any border meet 3:1 (1.4.3, 1.4.11).
- The arrow is decorative: link purpose comes from the headline text (2.4.4), not from the glyph alone (1.4.1).
